coverage_rule: All current peer branches included; registry wins over older protocol wording that says eight branches.

frank.relevance: Loop readouts, epochs, budgets and replay hashes contain numerics whose identity must not drift across lowerings.

clayresearch.relevance: Semantic-state identity and authority epochs require deterministic numeric representations but numeric canonicalization must not mint authority.

harness.relevance: Harness now separates semantic/source/runtime/trace identities and uses typed canonicalization; numeric leaf semantics are a remaining representation confound for differential replay.

claygraph.relevance: REAL weight/confidence plus epoch-bound receipts must remain derived observability; numeric canonicalization affects reproducible graph hashes/projections, not truth authority.

unifieddb.relevance: REAL confidence/priority/cost fields and Clay payloads cross persistence/query boundaries; semantic identity cannot depend on SQLite/host JSON formatting.

gwt.relevance: GWT readout vectors and effect/reentry measurements require typed finite numeric semantics and explicit unknown/conflict rather than accidental NaN coercion.

inputs: latest stack hyperposition emergence readout pointer
hyperposition.relevance: Coupling/gain/phase measurements must preserve numeric identity without collapsing alternative topology or ordered state.

emergenz.relevance: PID/PEID and causal readouts are sensitive to floating semantics; serialization determinism is measurement infrastructure, not emergence evidence.

claycode.relevance: Primary branch; test numeric canonical IR and host lowering boundary.

cross_branch_contradictions: Current G9 grammar has an undifferentiated decimal number token while current typed semantic identity work depends on type-directed canonicalization.
SQLite/Python/JavaScript/WASM numeric surfaces can carry the same conceptual quantity but do not share one serialization or all special-value behavior.
No branch evidence justifies treating NaN, Infinity, graph weights, GWT scores or loop readouts as execution authority.
